hypothesis.statement: Synchronous L2L produces the same logits as resident Qwen3 execution.
hypothesis.criterion: Written before the Ticket 03 acceptance run (after a disclosed pilot that compared HF and L2L logits only; see docs/l2l/03_sync_forward.md). Case forward_equivalence: on the same device, with the same weights and inputs, the synchronous L2L forward's logits equal the Hugging Face resident forward's, and its output after every decoder layer equals the explicit resident forward's, within research/l2l/tolerances.yaml (forward_equivalence: 0 for every quantity and dtype). Grid: both fixture shapes x eager/sdpa x fp32/bf16 x LoRA (plain model, adapter disabled, last2-attention, every projection of every layer) x 1 or 2 weight buffers x unpadded and left-padded inputs of several lengths x all, last-k and index-selected logit columns. The explicit resident forward must equal HF bitwise (reference integrity). Bounded residency (an execution requirement, not a threshold): at every decoder-layer call every frozen weight a kernel reads lies in the weight-buffer pool, the layer's weights are back in their CPU slab right after the call, the PyTorch-allocated device memory before each layer's copy is identical for every layer after the first, and after the forward it equals its value before the forward. NOT_SUPPORTED if any comparison exceeds its threshold.
